import json
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from part2.capital_flow import runner

def test_publish_failure_keeps_previous_complete_generation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    old, new = 1800000000000, 1800000060000
    runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=old)
    original = runner.atomic_write_json
    def fail_on_audit(path, payload):
        if Path(path).name == "audit_latest.json":
            raise OSError("injected audit publish failure")
        return original(path, payload)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, "atomic_write_json", fail_on_audit)
    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="injected audit publish failure"):
        runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=new)
    names = ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json")
    stamps = [json.loads((tmp_path / n).read_text())["as_of_ms"] for n in names]
    assert stamps == [old, old, old], dict(zip(names, stamps))
